question: In May 2025, which Indian state signed an MoU with IN-SPACe to establish a Space Tech Manufacturing Park and Centre of Excellence?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The state of **Karnataka** signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with **IN-SPACe** in **May 2025**. The MoU aims to establish a **Space Tech Manufacturing Park** and a **Centre of Excellence**.
 
• **IN-SPACe** (Indian National Space Promotion and Authorization Center) is an autonomous nodal agency under the Department of Space, Government of India, responsible for promoting and regulating private sector space activities in India.
 
• The Space Tech Manufacturing Park will serve as a hub for industries involved in manufacturing and innovation in the space sector. This initiative is expected to boost space research, technology development, and manufacturing capabilities within the state.
 
• The **Centre of Excellence** will focus on fostering research, education, and collaborations in the space technology domain, enabling startups and researchers to advance their innovations.
 
• Karnataka has established itself as a hub for technology and innovation, hosting significant space and aerospace industries, research institutions, and startups, which makes it a suitable location for such initiatives.
 
• This move aligns with India’s broader vision of boosting private participation and innovation in the space sector through initiatives led by IN-SPACe.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **IN-SPACe:**

 
 
• **IN-SPACe** was established in **2020** to enable, regulate, and promote private sector participation in the space industry.
 
• It acts as a bridge between the private sector and ISRO (Indian Space Research Organisation), facilitating the use of ISRO's facilities and resources for private players.
 
• IN-SPACe also provides a level playing field for private entities and startups to contribute to India’s space missions and technological advancements.
 
 
 
• **Karnataka’s Role in Space and Technology:**
 
 
• **Karnataka** is home to ISRO’s headquarters and several research centers, including the **Indian Space Research Organisation Satellite Centre (ISAC)** and the **Liquid Propulsion Systems Centre**.
 
• The state has a robust ecosystem for aerospace and defense industries, hosting major players like HAL (Hindustan Aeronautics Limited) and private sector companies.
 
• Bengaluru, the capital city, is often referred to as the **Silicon Valley of India** due to its thriving technology and innovation hubs.
 
 
 
• **Space Technology in India:**
 
 
• India has emerged as a significant player in the global space industry, with achievements like the **Chandrayaan missions**, **Mangalyaan** (Mars Orbiter Mission), and recent advancements in satellite technology.
 
• The government’s focus on increasing private sector participation is evident in the establishment of organizations like **IN-SPACe** and the reforms in the space policy.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Private Participation in Space:**

 
 
• The establishment of facilities like Space Tech Manufacturing Parks will create opportunities for private players to contribute to satellite manufacturing, launch services, and other space-related activities.
 
• This initiative is crucial for strengthening India’s position in the global space economy and achieving self-reliance in space technology.
 
 
 
• **Strategic Advantages of Karnataka:**
 
 
• The state’s existing infrastructure, talent pool, and proximity to research organizations make it an ideal location for space sector growth.
 
• This initiative will enhance Karnataka’s reputation as a leader in technology, innovation, and space research.
